title: vnodes node inventory (schema v2.1)
description: The single source of which machines exist. Declared by hand and changed only through `vnodes` plan -> approve -> apply. Holds names, addresses and declared capabilities only: never keys, tokens or passwords. Field names from document version 1 (name, ssh, os, role, roles, primary_for, host, enabled, clis, bash) are kept so v1 readers keep working. v2.1: the node definition is the standalone node.schema.json (urn:vigyan-nodes:schema:node:2.1); the document version stays 2 because 2.1 only adds optional fields.

inventory_node.description: A node record as stored in the inventory: the node schema plus the fields vnodes owns.
